analysis: The code calls isEmpty() on sharedGroups and invisibleSharedGroups. These calls can throw a NullPointerException if either collection is null. NullPointerException is a runtime exception. In a well-designed class, these fields should be initialized to non-null empty collections, so the potential exception indicates a programming error. It is not appropriate to catch NullPointerException in this context; instead, ensure the fields are never null. Therefore, no exception handling optimization is needed.
